name: Coot
summary: Interactive macromolecular atomic-model building, map inspection, refinement and validation.

steps: Read the maintainer's current installation section and select a route for the actual OS: Flatpak or distribution packaging on Linux, documented Homebrew formula on macOS, or the linked WinCoot installer on Windows. Coot may also be available through the separately installed CCP4 suite.

Review the selected package source, version, license and platform requirements before installing. Do not add an unstable system repository or execute a remote build script automatically; use any such route only after explicit user review.
Launch Coot interactively on a machine with a working graphical display. Confirm its version and that the GUI opens; inspect a user-approved model/map only when the user wants a scientific workflow.
install.verify_note: Check the installed version and successful local GUI launch. Headless command output does not verify graphics-dependent model-building features.

notes: Coot is a GUI model-building and validation tool, not a cryo-EM image reconstruction engine. Its packaging routes differ by OS and may involve system-wide changes, so this recipe is guidance-only.
Do not treat the repository's MIT license as changing Coot's own GPL/LGPL terms.
